title: Door wedge with grip ribs
about: a 120 mm door wedge with fifteen grip grooves on the underside, written by a loop
tries: Turn the V-grooves into a sawtooth that resists sliding away from the door | Add a second hanging hole and keep both inside the outline when H changes

agent.role: a designer of simple household prints who thinks in side profiles and loops
agent.prompt: Prefer editing the loop and the outline's expressions; keep the wedge one sketch and one extrude; never let a groove or the hang hole cut through the slope.

fragments.gap: Ask for the gap under the door and set H to about 1.5 times it.
fragments.grip: For tiles keep rib small and grooves dense; for carpet make rib deeper.
